issue_context.title: ScrollContainer touch input not working on android
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

4.0.beta1

### System information

Android 10 - Samsung Galaxy Tab S4 / Android 13 - One Plus 10 Pro

### Issue description

Using the scroll container on android, seems to ignore the touch input on the main scrollable content. Using the ScrollBar's at the bottom / left works, but is not really user-friendly on such small devices.

At the moment, it seems to be impossible to use touch input on the scrollable content, as nothing happens. I would expect to be able to scroll on the main content with my finger, which should move the scrollable content. 

The same behaviour can also be reproduced with the following setting enabled `input_devices/pointing/emulate_touch_from_mouse`. With this setting enabled in 3.5 you are able to emulate the panning on your desktop, that you would normally do on your phone. But this also does not seem to be working in 4.0.

My expected behavior fully aligns with what happens in the 3.5 reproduction.

Am I doing something wrong in my 4.0 scene? Or might this be a regression?

### Steps to reproduce

I have the following scene set up:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/30698007/190864874-e159f7c9-0734-4983-89e8-c063b12460c8.png)

The mouse filter of the texture rect is set to PASS, same goes for the scroll container, as this is the default value when adding to the scene.

I have also reproduced the exact same scene in 3.5, which works flawlessly.

### Minimal reproduction project

For 4.0: [ScrollContainer_touch_input_reproduction_v4.0.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/9592048/ScrollContainer_touch_input_reproduction_v4.0.zip)

For 3.5 (was built with the mono version, don't know if that matters): [ScrollContainer_touch_input_reproduction_v3.5.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/9592057/ScrollContainer_touch_input_reproduction_v3.5.zip)
